title: Production Manager – Injection Molding
description:
We are looking for an experienced **Production Manager** with 10–15 years of hands-on experience in **Injection Molding Production**. The candidate will be responsible for managing the complete production process, ensuring production targets, quality standards, productivity and timely delivery are achieved.

Key Responsibilities

* Plan, organize and manage daily injection molding production activities.
* Prepare and execute production plans according to customer requirements and dispatch schedules.
* Manage manpower, machines, molds and materials to achieve production targets.
* Monitor production quantity, rejection, downtime and machine utilization.
* Improve **OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness)** and machine productivity.
* Control production wastage, rejection and material consumption.
* Identify production problems and conduct **Root Cause Analysis (RCA)** to prevent recurrence.
* Optimize injection molding processes to improve productivity and reduce production costs.
* Coordinate with Quality, Maintenance, PPC, Stores and other departments for smooth production.
* Implement and maintain **5S and Kaizen** practices on the shop floor.
* Ensure compliance with **ISO 9001** quality systems and standard operating procedures.
* Monitor process parameters and ensure consistent product quality.
* Develop and implement preventive actions for recurring production and quality issues.
* Train, guide and manage production supervisors, operators and workers.
* Maintain production reports and analyze daily/monthly production performance.
* Ensure proper housekeeping, discipline and safety practices on the production floor.

Technical Skills Required

* Strong knowledge of **Injection Molding Production**.
* Production Planning & Control (**PPC**).
* Knowledge of **OEE improvement** and productivity enhancement.
* **5S and Kaizen** implementation.
* **Root Cause Analysis** and problem-solving.
* Process optimization and cycle-time reduction.
* Rejection and waste control.
* Knowledge of **ISO 9001 quality systems**.
* Good manpower and shop-floor management skills.

**Added Advantage:** Experience in **PET Preform Production/Process** will be preferred.

Candidate Profile

Candidates should have strong hands-on experience in injection molding production and the ability to independently manage production operations, manpower and production targets. Good communication, leadership and problem-solving skills are essential.

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹60,000.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* Do you have 10–15 years of experience in Injection Molding Production?
* Have you independently managed injection molding production, including manpower, machines, production targets, rejection and downtime?
* Do you have hands-on knowledge of PPC, OEE improvement, 5S, Kaizen, Root Cause Analysis and process optimization?
* Do you have experience with PET Preform production? If yes, please mention your experience.

Work Location: In person

title: Injection Moulding Production Manager
description:
**Job Description – Injection Moulding Production Manager**

We are hiring an experienced Injection Moulding Production Manager for handling overall production operations in plastic manufacturing.

Responsibilities:

* Manage Injection Moulding, Blow Moulding & Assembly operations
* Plan and monitor daily production targets
* Ensure product quality and minimum rejection
* Handle manpower, machine utilization & production efficiency
* Coordinate with maintenance, quality & dispatch teams
* Maintain production reports and shift planning
* Ensure safety and process discipline on shop floor

Requirements:

* Strong knowledge of Injection Moulding, Blow Moulding & Assembly
* Candidate must be from Preform, Cap & Closure, or Packaging Container industry background
* Experience in production planning and team handling
* Ability to solve production and quality issues efficiently
* Good leadership and communication skills

Pay: ₹55,000.00 - ₹60,000.00 per month

Application Question(s):
